name: @w6w-apps/acumbamail
description: Manage Acumbamail email marketing: subscriber lists, subscribers, campaigns, templates, transactional email, SMS and list webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Acumbamail is an email and SMS marketing platform. This app drives its REST API from a workflow.

Create and delete subscriber lists, read their stats and fields, add merge fields; add, batch-add, search, unsubscribe and delete subscribers; create and send campaigns and read their totals, openers, clickers, links and ISP/browser/OS breakdowns; create and duplicate templates; send a transactional email or SMS; and configure a list's event webhook.

Acumbamail's API is a flat set of named functions (https://acumbamail.com/api/1/{function}/) authenticated by a per-account auth token; the vendor documents several functions with per-minute request limits, and answers 429 past them.
